message.content:
**Answer**

The rs7412 variant (the “T” allele at position 19:45411941 on chromosome 19, which defines the APOE E2 allele) occurs in roughly **10–12 %** of alleles in European populations. In the 1000 Genomes Project Phase 3 dataset, the allele frequency for rs7412 in the European (EUR) superpopulation is about **0.12** (≈ 12 %). Frequencies can vary slightly among sub‑populations (e.g., higher in some Southern European groups, lower in Northern/Western groups).

**Sources**

| Source | Frequency (EUR) | Link |
|--------|-----------------|------|
| 1000 Genomes Project Phase 3 (Phase 3 v5) | 0.12 | https://www.internationalgenome.org/data-portal/ |
| gnomAD v3.1 (Exomes + Genomes) | 0.118 | https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/variant/19-45411941-T-C |

**Quick reference**

- **rs7412** (APOE E2 allele) – T allele frequency ≈ 0.12 in Europeans.  
- **rs429358** (APOE E4 allele) – T allele frequency ≈ 0.08 in Europeans.  

These figures are averages across the combined European superpopulation; individual studies may report slightly different values depending on the specific cohort.
